notes.title: Free PC game - Dave the Diver, but with a dark secret
notes.content:
Godlike Burger is a little different from your average restaurant sim. While the likes of Overcooked, Dave the Diver, Plate Up, and Cook, Serve, Delicious all do a great job of capturing the hectic, all hands on deck nature of running an eatery, the food you're serving is pretty by the books. Not so in Godlike Burger, which can be yours for free right now, so be sure to grab it while you can.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Serving Next: Steam Awards!
notes.content:
Heyho everybody!

We hope you enjoy frying all those space burgers!

It's once again the time of the year! The autumn sale is in full swing and comes with
its annual celebration of video games: The Steam Awards.

And that's where you come in.
We're proud of the work we put into Godlike Burger and obviously feel that it is the best game ever developed - and if you only think the slightest bit alike, nominating us only makes perfect sense, right? 

These are the awards for which we feel most eligible:

[list]
[*] Best Game You Suck At
[*] Best Soundtrack
[*] Game of the Year
[*] Innovative Gameplay
[*] Outstanding Visual Style
[/list]

If you prefer to nominate us for other awards, that's great as well!
Thank you so much for your support and your help with nominating us for the Steam Awards!

Team Liquid Pug & Daedalic Entertainment

notes.title: New Balancing Patch
notes.content:
[b]Greetings fellow spaaaace chefs![/b]

Today we release another patch with a plate full of fixes and improvements. What you’ll find on the menu:
[list]
[*] Cryotube now allows the player to save unlocked planets, as well as restart a session: You can buy any (affordable) planet and freely visit them after death, reset or restart. Unlocked and saved planets will no longer provide any quests or require traveling fees as well as imposed prestige requirements.
[*] Second Chances amount is set to unlimited, so the player would be able to buy as many as desired, a new counter indicates the current number.
[*] Quest generation and distribution improved.
[*] You can now carry multiple buns at once.
[*] Updated the Tutorial according to the changes. 
[*] Fixed various input related issues.
[*] Updated localization and Credits.
[/list]

Enjoy your meal!

Greetings from Team Liquid Pug & Daedalic Entertainment.

notes.title: New Patch is live
New Hotfix is here!
notes.content:
[b]Heyho Space Chefs,[/b]

we just released a small hotfix with quest fixes! 

It addresses the following and more:

[list]
[*] Fixed bugs in quests related to sauces
[*] Fixed cases where quests related to customer service were not counting
[*] Clarified text formulations of some quests
[*] Situations in which, after purchasing all the upgrades, some quests could become impassable

[/list]

notes.title: New Hotfix just went live
notes.content:
Heyho everyone,

we just released a small hotfix to tackle 2 of the most pressing issues you were facing: Not detecting the gamepad and the annoying "corrupted savegame issue"! 

This is only one step further on our list and we are already working on the next one: Broken Quests.

Have a great day and get some healthy burgers into your system!


Changelog:

[list]
[*] Fixed: Issue where the game wasn't able to properly detect gamepads as input
[*] Fixed: Issue where savegames could get corrupted due to unforseen game exit and the game was no longer playable. The solution now provides a fallback in combination with the save game history and a detection system to provide new savegames to the player to make the game accessible again. We sincererly apologize for any lost progress.
[/list]

notes.title: New Patch is here!
notes.content:
Heyho, Kitchen Chefs!

It has been an extreme first 2 weeks after Godlike Burger hit the Stores and we are so glad that seemingly you enjoy what we had to deliver! 

We have been reading your posts in the forum and our discord meticulously and even though we were not able to answer to everyone individually, we are doing our best to keep you up to date with everything surrounding the game and the few issues you faced after release. 

Some of you might already know, but roughly 2 months ago half of the dev team was located in ukraine - you probably can imagine what that means and we agreed among ourselves not to bring this topic up in our public communication prior to release. 
Seeing now (as the publisher) how well Godlike Burgers Dev Team juggles working on the found issues while at the same time settling in an unknown country with a lot of bureaucracy ahead, justifies at least honoring and mentioning to you the actual situation, despite a lot of struggles and hurdles, they are rockin' it.... But without further ado - here are the known issues and next steps:

With todays patch, we included the following smaller fixes:

- 'Out of stamina' indicator added to the basement
- UI adjustments & improvements
- Credits updated

Furthermore we are working to find solutions to the most pressing issues, for example the corruption of savegames and issues with input detection. In some cases of those we succeeded already to find a fix and sent them into testing - That means, if the new fixes aren't breaking anything else they should be included in the following update.

Best Regards!

notes.title: Godlike Burger is out now!
notes.content:
Prepare your ingredients, mark your recipe, it’s time to cook!

Godlike Burger – the restaurant management game crossed with a serial killer sim is launching today! Flip patties in space while avoiding cops chasing you for your murderous deeds!

[previewyoutube=aZsDOb7Wqyc;full][/previewyoutube]

Godlike Burger presents you with an interesting situation - you’re a burger chef in space, your mission is to cook the most delicious burgers for the denizens of the galaxy! The catch is that the aliens you feed are also your primary ingredient! Be careful though, where there is crime, there is punishment, as efficient as you are at flipping burgers, you’ll need to exercise the same efficiency in evading the authorities if you want your restaurant to keep operating!

Godlike Burger is out now!

Key Features

[list]
[*] Kill your customers with a range of hidden traps or the good old meat cleaver! Their delicious meat is your special ingredient after all.

[*] Cook the best burgers and turn your pitiful burger joint into the universe’s most famous restaurant.

[*] Improve your kitchen and find out what each alien race likes - uncover the secret of the perfect burger.

[*] Explore the galaxy and its worlds. There are different alien species and their individual strengths and weaknesses to discover.

[*] Don’t get caught! Leave no witnesses and keep the police’s suspicion low by playing and planning smartly.
[/list]

notes.title: Release Date Announcement
notes.content:
What delicious news!

We're excited to announce the release date for Godlike Burger - a space travelling, alien-cooking management sim! 

In Godlike Burger, you'll be taking the reins of a galaxy-trotting burger joint to ensure that alien stomachs of all shapes and sizes are all full and satiated!  There has to be a catch, right?! Well…not only are you a cook, you're also a pretty efficient serial killer. Your goal? Feed aliens to [b]other[/b] aliens!

[previewyoutube=SsiA2i9yFQ0;full]Trailer:[/previewyoutube]

Turn your customers into delicious ingredients, expand your business and go on a quest to produce the greatest burger in the galaxy. You'll get to create the most delicious and unusual burgers in the universe and travel the galaxy in a flying space diner in search of new inspiration.

Acquire new ingredients (read: lure customers into traps and then turn them into patties), manage your restaurant and avoid getting caught! Don't stay in one place too long - the space police are always on the lookout for the crazy culinarian with a bloody cleaver.

We hope you'll enjoy this galaxy-spanning culinary murderspree when it releases on April 21st!

notes.title: Godlike Burger Stream
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39258136/f3700bd0ccc0939fbc8de0c51590f87ce7eec78e.gif[/img]

[b]Godlike Burger[/b] is a cooking simulator and business management game with a strong touch of dark humor and brutal murders!

You are a crazy chef preparing the most unusual and delicious burgers in the universe. Your restaurant is located on a flying space platform, able to travel from planet to planet. What is the secret of your godlike burgers? Well, they contain pieces of your customers of course!

Make burgers, run a restaurant, kill aliens and of course: don’t get caught!

[h2]Gameplay[/h2]

During the day, different aliens arrive to be served those delicious burgers at your space restaurant. Well, or to be killed and turned into minced meat. The freezers don’t fill themselves, right?

[b]Run the kitchen,[/b] prepare burgers that suit different alien’s tastes, upgrade your appliances and make space money!

[b]Use deadly traps or your trusty cleaver[/b] to kill some of your customers for fresh supplies. Nobody will notice that alien not returning from the bathroom, right? If you need more time to do some stealthy murder, try mixing some laxatives into a customer’s burger… that will surely result in some extra time being spent in the bathroom.

[b]Increase your restaurant’s prestige level[/b] and travel from planet to planet until no one can resist your godlike burgers. But don’t stay in one place for too long! Space police will surely become suspicious if too many inhabitants of a planet go missing. And if the cops decide to visit your restaurant to take a closer look, better be on your best behaviour!

[b]Manage your restaurant:[/b] At night you have some peace and quiet to finally do what every good restaurant owner must do: Manage your restaurant and prepare for another busy day. Cook “sauces”, stock up on ingredients, upgrade your kitchen appliances.

[b]Well, in your case there’s more to the job:[/b] Don’t forget to set up and upgrade your traps. You might also bribe the police to make sure business can run smoothly. There’s always something to do if you want to be the best burger joint in the universe!

[h2]Key Features[/h2]

[list][*]Cook the best burgers and turn your pitiful burger joint into the universe’s most famous restaurant.
[*]Kill your customers with a range of hidden traps, poison or the good old meat cleaver! Their delicious meat is your special ingredient after all.
[*]Improve your kitchen and find out what each alien race likes - uncover the secret of the perfect burger.
[*]Explore the galaxy and its worlds. There are different alien species and their individual strengths and weaknesses to discover.
[*]Don’t get caught! Leave no witnesses and keep the police’s suspicion low by playing and planning smartly.[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39258136/11185a63a65d5c9e9f736b9dbde5eb4a669761fd.gif[/img]
